messages:
marta.eng: Heads-up — trying to onboard Aurora-7B-v1 into the model catalog. License attached here: https://upstream.example/licenses/aurora-7b-v1.txt

marta.eng: Key clauses: `Section 2: NonCommercial use only`, `Section 5: No redistribution of weights or derivatives`, `Section 7: Attribution required in docs`. Trying to figure out what we can offer (hosted API? private deploy?)

kevin.mlops: Quick q — we were planning to run 4-bit quant experiments and keep quantized weights in our infra. Does that count as "derivative" under this license?

john.legal: Short answer: likely yes. If license forbids redistribution of weights/derivatives, producing and sharing quantized weights outside upstream control is risky. Hosting inference without providing downloads might still be allowed, but depends on how "commercial" is defined.

john.legal: Need to confirm whether our hosted API counts as a "commercial service" under their terms. Many NC clauses treat any paid service as commercial. If so, we can't expose Aurora on hosted endpoints to paying customers.

sara.research: For evaluation internal-only (no external customers) we can run quant experiments, right? The clause seems aimed at distribution but wording is fuzzy.

john.legal: Internal evals are lower risk if kept behind access controls and not redistributed. But if we hand quantized weights to a customer or include them in Private deployments, that would violate the redistribution clause.

liz.product: So product tradeoffs: (1) Offer Aurora only in a read-only hosted sandbox for free trials? (2) Offer for Dedicated/Private customers only if upstream grants exception? (3) Block onboarding until legal clears? Thoughts?

kevin.mlops: Implementation-wise we can gate model picks: prevent private deploy option and remove "download weights" button. Also tag model as "non-commercial" so billing blocks it for paid routes.

marta.eng: @john.legal — can you draft a short checklist of permitted vs forbidden actions so engineering can implement gating?

john.legal: Will do. Tentative checklist: `Allowed: run inference for internal research; offer hosted evaluation free of charge to users with explicit license acknowledgement; produce aggregated outputs (text) for customers with attribution.` `Forbidden: provide model weights (full or quantized) to third parties; embed model in customer-managed environments without upstream permission; monetize the model via paid API endpoints.`

license-bot: License scan complete — flag HIGH_RISK (non-commercial + no redistribution). See /licenses/aurora-7b-v1-report.pdf

sara.research: One nuance: attribution requirement — does that mean we must include specific wording in API responses or just in product docs? License text says "attribution in any downstream use" which could be interpreted broadly.

john.legal: Attribution usually means documentation and marketing, not every generated string. But the license language here is broad. We'll ask upstream to clarify exact obligations and preferred attribution text.

liz.product: Actionable plan from product side: pause catalog listing; add "license: review in progress" badge; offer ephemeral demo in internal sandbox only. Notify sales to not promise Private deployments.

kevin.mlops: I'll implement soft blocks in model registry by EOD: disable private_deploy flag, hide weight export.

marta.eng: I'll put the Aurora onboarding PR on hold and link this thread. Also adding quantization notes to the PR so reviewers know it's blocked.

john.legal: I'll email upstream (cc'ing @liz.product) to request: (A) confirmation that hosted inference is allowed for paid services, (B) permission to create and use quantized weights internally, and (C) a short attribution blurb we can show in product docs. Expect a reply in 2–3 business days.

liz.product: Thanks. If upstream refuses commercial license, we'll remove Aurora from roadmap for Dedicated/Private and mark it as "research-only".

marta.eng: Thanks all. For tracking: created ticket INF-9723 with checklist and assigned to john.legal + kevin.mlops.

john.legal: Added requested checklist to INF-9723. Will update thread with upstream response. :memo:

license-bot: INF-9723 linked to license incident ID LIC-2026.

marta.eng: OK closing out immediate onboarding work until legal confirms.
